rosterJokes.Ilir Asllani: You've got Josh Allen carrying this entire roster like he's a single-engine plane full of dead weight—Bijan's your only other competent player, and the rest of your bench is a graveyard of injury reserves, washed-up journeymen, and handcuff desperation picks that won't see the field. rosterJokes.Arben Sinanaj: Arben's roster is a masterclass in chasing last year's ghosts while ignoring this year's reality—Courtland Sutton went from 182 points to a pathetic 24.8, Terry McLaurin's been a ghost, and Blake Corum's been basically useless, yet somehow JSN is carrying this entire dumpster fire on his back. rosterJokes.Flamur Muriqi: Your roster is basically a highlight reel of "I thought this guy would bounce back" mixed with injury report bingo—Saquon's questionable, Brooks and Mason are on IR doing their best impressions of ghosts, and you're out here rostering two defenses like that's the move when your RB depth is held together by duct tape and prayers. rosterJokes.Nori Kastrati: Nori, you built a roster like you were drafting for a hospital ward—Breece Hall is doubtful, Deebo's out, Alec Pierce and Isiah Pacheco are on IR, Jordan Addison is questionable, and you still thought rostering two backup QBs and a practice squad WR in Efton Chism was the move. rosterJokes.Rilind Ahmetaj: Rilind's roster is a masterclass in chasing last year's ghosts while ignoring the present—DeVonta Smith and Brian Thomas Jr. are both underperforming or hurt, Rico Dowdle went from 196 points to 8.5 faster than his offensive line can, and somehow he's got three tight ends all limping around like he confused "depth chart" with "injury report." rosterJokes.Rinor Ahmetaj: You drafted like you were playing fantasy football with a broken spine—De'Von Achane is on IR, DJ Moore is perpetually questionable, and you somehow managed to waste roster spots on Justice Hill and Romeo Doubs while they collected dust on your bench. Devaughn Vele?) that make it look like you panic-drafted after your third beer, and running two defenses while your actual skill positions are this thin is the cherry on top of this dumpster fire.
rosterJokes.Rob Ricigliano: Rob, you've got Christian McCaffrey and Kyren Williams carrying this entire roster like they're in a fucking retirement home—meanwhile you're rostering Dameon Pierce and Pierre Strong Jr., two guys who've combined for 5.5 points and make Jadarian Price look like a league winner. rosterJokes.Veton Gjonbalaj: You've got more guys on the injury report than on the field—Travis Etienne, Josh Jacobs, Zach Charbonnet, and Jalen Hurts are all either out or day-to-day, which is a great strategy if your goal was to run a hospital ward instead of a fantasy team. rosterJokes.Jetmir Asllani / Peter Mardjonovic: You drafted like you were playing survivor mode instead of actually trying to win, loading up on washed vets and lottery tickets while Kenneth Walker and Tetairoa McMillan crater harder than a Chicago Bears playoff drive. rosterJokes.Ben Vucetaj: Ben, you've assembled a fantasy team that looks like you were drafting while having a stroke—half your roster is hovering over the injury report like vultures, and the other half are waiver-wire dart throws that somehow landed worse than a blindfolded Ben Simmons. rosterJokes.Faton Muriqi: Faton's roster looks like he panic-drafted every backup who had one good game and then held onto them like they were lottery tickets—James Cook carrying the load while Colston Loveland, Rome Odunze, and Wan'Dale Robinson all crater harder than a rookie QB's confidence, and somehow rostering two QB's including a Saints backup tells us everything we need to know about his decision-making. Ray Davis with 5.3 points and Chris Rodriguez Jr. in the mix is the fantasy equivalent of showing up to the draft hungover and just pointing at names you vaguely remember.
rosterJokes.Adam Vilajeti: Adam, you drafted like you were trying to build a hospital wing instead of a fantasy team—A.J.
